independence_instructions: This is an AI-assisted audit and does not satisfy the independent-human annotation requirement.
Use only public task, quality, scenario, metric, overlay, source, and test evidence.
Do not inspect reference branches, solution patches, or model-generated answers.
rationale: Cachetools has two compact, natural implementation surfaces: key construction and decorator factories. Decorator behavior consumes hashkey, typedkey, and method-key semantics, so concurrent work can encode stale assumptions even when patches merge cleanly. The worker ownership boundary is suitable, although secondary integrator-only metric points should be excluded from cross-worker CAIL and SAD aggregates.
